articles.summary: We show how to extract novel and human-understandable concepts from the recently released Steerling-8B model.
articles.title: Discovering Human-understandable Concepts in Steerling-8B

articles.summary: We release Steerling-8B, an 8B-parameter causal diffusion language model that is interpretable by construction — its predictions are routed through concepts you can measure, audit, and control.
articles.title: Steerling-8B: The First Inherently Interpretable Language Model

articles.summary: We demonstrate reliable, fine-grained control over language model generation by directly injecting, suppressing, and composing human-interpretable concepts at inference time.
articles.title: Steering Interpretable Language Models
